meta_title: Scrybe — Local subtitles for your own broadcasts
meta_description: Caption any audio source, and integrate directly with OBS. Customized for your stream. You are in full control. Free, Fully local, open-source, no cloud.
hero_subtitle: Turn your microphone or desktop audio into captions privately. Style them to match your stream, and use OBS the way you're already used to.
hero_subtitle_caution: Still in early development. Expect many changes.
hero_caption_float: and this is what it looks like on stream
hero_caption_phrase_2: free, fully local, open-source, no cloud
trust_free_body: No fees, no subscription, no API key required.
trust_privacy_body: Data never leaves your computer. All audio and text processing happens where you have full control over it.
trust_creator_body: Live captions and an OBS overlay, built around your existing stream tools.
workflow_heading: Four steps from install to on-stream captions.
workflow_body: Scrybe is a standalone desktop app, install it like any normal program. Choose from a set of model presets (or bring your own) and start transcribing.
workflow_step_audio_body: Scrybe is a standalone desktop app, install it like any normal program.
workflow_step_style_title: Customize the caption box's positioning, color, and size.
workflow_step_style_body: Adjust text alignment, color, font size, transparency, etc and the overlay will update automatically.
workflow_step_obs_body: Drop the overlay URL into OBS and the captions appear.
workflow_step_live_body: Choose from a set of model presets (or bring your own) and start transcribing.
features_heading: Local captions for your own broadcasts.
features_body: Explore the different ways Scrybe can be used.
feat_local_body: Scrybe runs speech recognition on your computer. Choose from one of the built-in presets, or use your own model file.
feat_audio_body: Choose a microphone, desktop audio, or even a virtual audio device.
feat_style_body: Add the local overlay URL as a browser source in OBS. Adjust the alignment, font size, background color, and opacity to suit your stream.
feat_obs_body_post: into OBS and the captions appear. Adjust text alignment, color, font size, transparency, etc and the overlay will update automatically.
feat_twitch_body: A planned Scrybe OBS plugin would send native captions to Twitch. Viewers could turn them on with the player’s CC button.
feat_twitch_footnote: Microphone mute events are also planned for the plugin.

demo_transcript_2: Thank you for the raid itswill.
demo_transcript_3: Scrybe processes your audio on your computer.
demo_transcript_4: Choose a preset that suits your computer.
demo_transcript_5: All right, back to the game.
how_heading: From installation to captions on stream.
how_body: Install the desktop app, prepare your captions, and add the overlay to an OBS scene.
how_step_1_body: Download Scrybe for your operating system. The app currently downloads a model preset for local transcription.
how_step_2_body: Open the Overlay page to adjust the caption box’s position, size, colors, and text.
how_step_3_body: Create a browser source in OBS and paste this local overlay URL.
how_step_4_body: Choose your audio source in Settings, then select Start captions. Your captions appear in the overlay.
planned_audio_body: Capture audio from a specific process, follow changes to the system default, and keep captioning when the source switches.
planned_transcripts_body: Further improvements to caption segmentation and speaker identification are planned.
planned_obs_body: A segment-log overlay and a dedicated OBS plugin for Twitch native captions and microphone mute events.
tech_body: Scrybe embeds whisper.cpp for local speech recognition. Model files are downloaded for use on your computer.
tech_stat_compute_label: Hardware acceleration depends on the platform and build
tech_whisper_body: whisper.cpp is Georgi Gerganov's port of OpenAI's Whisper speech-recognition model to plain C/C++.
tech_overlay_body: Scrybe exposes captions over an easy to use browser source. Add the overlay URL, adjust text alignment, color, font size, transparency, etc and the overlay will update automatically.
tech_platforms_body: Download for macOS, Windows, Linux · Debian/Ubuntu, or Linux · Fedora/RHEL.
tech_project_body: Built by synthlabs. Open source — repository.
